standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Hypercoverings, the lemma producing the spectral sequence computing the cohomology of a sheaf from its alternating sections over a hypercovering
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification of R-Gamma of a single sheaf with the alternating complex of its sections over the hypercovering.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher cohomology over a weakly contractible object
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology on Sites, the lemma that a weakly contractible object has vanishing higher cohomology with coefficients in any sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the vanishing hypothesis that makes the spectral sequence degenerate in the case of a single sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Spectral sequences of a double complex of a map of complexes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, the lemma giving the two spectral sequences of a first quadrant double complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the quasi-isomorphism criterion for the map of total complexes and the identification of the total complex of the injective resolution as computing R-Gamma.

core_obligations: Case of a single sheaf (proof lines 3295-3302): if E is an abelian sheaf then the Cech spectral sequence of the hypercovering implies that the global sections functor applied to the alternating complex of sections over K computes R-Gamma, because the higher cohomology of any sheaf over a weakly contractible object vanishes.

Pass to a bounded below complex (proof lines 3304-3314): choose an injective resolution of the complex and consider the induced map of total complexes of the alternating complexes; for every degree the map on sections over U_n is a quasi-isomorphism because sections over U_n are exact, so by one of the spectral sequences of a double complex the displayed map is a quasi-isomorphism.

Conclude (proof lines 3314-3324): by the single sheaf case each of the complexes of sections of the injective resolution over K is acyclic in positive degrees and computes its degree zero value, so the other spectral sequence shows that the total complex of the alternating complex of the injective resolution computes R-Gamma(U, E).
proof_roadmap: Prove the statement for a single sheaf by degenerating the Cech spectral sequence using the vanishing over weakly contractible objects.
Resolve the bounded below complex by injectives and compare total complexes by a double complex spectral sequence.
Use the single sheaf case to identify the target total complex with the derived global sections.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a bounded below complex on the pro-etale site of a scheme and a hypercovering whose terms are weakly contractible objects, the derived global sections are computed by the total complex of the alternating complex of sections (statement lines 3282-3293). The proof (proof lines 3295-3327) handles a single sheaf through the Cech spectral sequence and the vanishing over weakly contractible objects, then passes to bounded below complexes through an injective resolution compared by a double complex spectral sequence. H2: two steps with three inputs, written out in full.
